defects.title: The consistency check stops with an error instead of relaxing an inconsistent network
defects.trigger: S = sparse([-1 0 1 -1; 1 -1 0 0; 0 1 -1 2]) (A, B, C; R1: A -> B, R2: B -> C, R3: C -> A, R4: A -> 2 C); minCardinalityConservationRelaxationVector(S, struct('epsilon', 1e-4), 0) (param without checkConsistency -> default 1, line 55) or checkConsistency = 1
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25) consistency LP infeasible (stat 0), then error 'solve for minimum cardinality of conservation relaxation vector failed' (line 166); printLevel 3: 'Unrecognized field name "x".' at line 148. Line 83 sets done = 1 whatever the LP status, so no relaxation follows the check
defects.expected: check 'prior to relaxation' (help) then relaxation: relaxRxnBool = [0 0 0 1], as the same S gives with param omitted

defects.title: The upper bounds of the relaxation problem are built with swapped lengths
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25) optimizeCardinality stat 0 (INF_OR_UNBD), error 'solve ... failed': line 102 builds ub = [inf(nlt,1); (1/epsilon)*ones(mlt,1)] with mlt = #reactions, nlt = #metabolites, so x(2) = 3z >= 3 is capped at 2; the documented LP (x + S'z = 0, x free, 1 <= z <= 2) has stat 1, x = [-1; 3], z = 1; mirrored S = [-3 1] gives relaxRxnBool = [1 1]

notes: Reproduction: changeCobraSolver('gurobi','all',0); S = sparse([-1 0 1 -1; 1 -1 0 0; 0 1 -1 2]); rng(0); [rb, sr] = minCardinalityConservationRelaxationVector(S)  % rb = [0 0 0 1] (checkConsistency 0 when param omitted); rng(0); minCardinalityConservationRelaxationVector(S, struct('epsilon', 1e-4), 0)  % error line 166; rng(0); minCardinalityConservationRelaxationVector(sparse([1 -3]), struct('epsilon', 0.5, 'checkConsistency', 0), 0)  % error line 166; with sparse([-3 1]) -> [1 1]. Reach: only caller findStoichConsistentSubset always sets minCardRelaxParams.checkConsistency = 0 (line 99), so it never reaches the first defect; the second (bounds) affects every relaxation call with #rxns ~= #mets, i.e. findStoichConsistentSubset lines 227 and 329 (the bound only binds when a relaxation needs |x| > 1/epsilon, or z of the first m-n mets is left unbounded when m > n). findStoichConsistentSubset line 500 passes a number (epsilon) as param, which would fail in this function (dot assignment on a double) - caller's issue, for its own row.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: swapped lengths of the relaxation bounds, error with checkConsistency (writer reproduced); default reach
